emails.subject: Paid receipt QB-2025-118
emails.body: Payment for archival tissue and label sleeves was received in full on 4 February 2025. Order QB-2025-118 was delivered and the account has no remaining balance.

emails.subject: 2025 program records transfer complete
emails.body: The Harbor Municipal Archive accepted the museum's public program records transfer on 18 March 2025. The inventory matched the delivered cartons, and no additional material is requested.
